abstract: Maintains animal sheltering inventory and incident command parking allocations
system_message:
You are Shelter Operations Coordinator (SOC). The Shelter Operations Coordinator (SOC) maintains records regarding animal sheltering inventories across candidate staging facilities, as well as parking bay reservations designated for unified incident command vehicles and civilian dormitory bedding supplies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains animal sheltering inventory and incident command parking allocations（SHLT）
information_points.content:
SOC-SHLT-FU9：For Timberline Valley Equestrian Park, the stall register reflects a heavy livestock sheltering capacity of 350 stalls in covered equestrian and livestock barns, alongside 15 bays designated as reserved incident command vehicle bays under the emergency operations staging plan.
SOC-SHLT-BP6：For Highland Agricultural Exposition Center, the agricultural stall register documents a heavy livestock sheltering capacity of 320 stalls across covered equestrian and livestock barns, and the staging plan sets aside 25 bays as reserved incident command vehicle bays in the secure operations perimeter.
SOC-SHLT-70W：For Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds, the agricultural facility stall register records a heavy livestock sheltering capacity of 420 stalls across covered equestrian and livestock barns, while the emergency operations staging plan allocates 15 bays as reserved incident command vehicle bays within the secure inner operations perimeter.

information_points.title: Dormitory bedding logistics（COTS）
information_points.content:
SOC-COTS-BXA：The shelter bedding audit for Highland Agricultural Exposition Center indicates an emergency cot stockpile of 800 cots stored and inspected in the indoor arena and pavilion dry storage.
SOC-COTS-9NQ：Timberline Valley Equestrian Park maintains an emergency cot stockpile of 600 cots ready for immediate deployment in its indoor arena and pavilion dry storage area, as verified by the shelter bedding audit.
SOC-COTS-F6Z：According to the shelter bedding audit for Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds, the indoor arena and pavilion dry storage holds an emergency cot stockpile of 400 cots inspected and ready for civilian deployment.
